title: Neighborhood pet-sitting marketplace (paraphrase)
idea: An Android and iOS app that lets residents of a single residential tower hire each other on short notice to walk a dog or look after a cat while they are away. Whoever does the job keeps four fifths of what the customer pays; the app retains the remaining fifth. Confidence in a caretaker comes from three things: a scan of their national identity card, a short self-recorded video, and the fact that their first three jobs carry no fee at all. Nothing has been arranged with an underwriter, so before a booking is confirmed the animal's owner taps a screen accepting that any harm is on them. Only tall buildings in Jakarta are served at launch.
focus_notes: Take-rate vs neighbor disintermediation (go off-app after intro)
